security.csp: default-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost https://api.modrinth.com https://github.com https://objects.githubusercontent.com; img-src 'self' asset: http://asset.localhost https://cdn.modrinth.com data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'

updater.//: Self-update is NOT wired up: release.yml builds --no-bundle, so no NSIS installer and no latest.json are published, and no signing keypair exists. The plugin stays registered (removing the key breaks startup) but the empty pubkey makes app_updater::check refuse, and updater:default is withheld in capabilities/default.json so the webview cannot reach plugin:updater directly. To enable: generate a keypair, set pubkey, flip createUpdaterArtifacts to true, re-add updater:default, and publish latest.json.
